sloka: उत्पात वात अभिहता नाना द्विज गण आयुताः ।मा भैः इति विधूत अग्रा व्याजह्रुः इव पादपाः ॥३-५२-३४॥
transliteration: utpāta vāta abhihatā nānā dvija gaṇa āyutāḥ ।mā bhaiḥ iti vidhūta agrā vyājahruḥ iva pādapāḥ ॥3-52-34॥

translations.english: The trees filled with birds of all kinds, shaken at the top by stormy winds seemed to be saying to Sita, 'Be not afraid'.
